title: 🎨 Palette: Add tooltips and ARIA labels to destructive buttons
body:
💡 What: Added aria-label and title to destructive action buttons (Wipe, Delete this mock).
🎯 Why: Ensure visual tooltips on hover for sighted users and proper context for screen readers.
📸 Before/After: Visual tooltips are now shown.
♿ Accessibility: Added explicit ARIA labels and titles to destructive action buttons.
head: feature/palette-a11y-destructive-buttons
